name: click-wave-emitter
title: Click Wave Emitter
description: An omnidirectional pulse origin emitting expanding wave ripples outward upon any pointer down event.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Click Origin Wave Pulse: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
